kjv: He (the king) shall have dominion also from sea to sea
mine: May he (the king) have dominion from sea to sea
note: the verbs of vv.2-17 are mostly jussives (yadin, yishpot, weyerd "may he rule"), a prayer for the king; the KJV renders them as future predictions ("he shall"), which supports a messianic reading.

kjv: There shall be an handful of corn in the earth
mine: May there be abundance of grain in the land
note: pissat bar: pissah is a hapax, probably "abundance" (from pss "spread"); the rabbinic "handful" suggests scarcity, the opposite of the context.
